title: piper prunifolium var. carboneranum
intro: Piper prunifolium var. carboneranum, commonly known as Carbonero, is a plant species belonging to the Piperaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Carbonero include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of various infections. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
